pages.text: Upon consumption, grants the eater:$(br)$(li)v$(li)Shot arrows will produce a 3.5-second dense arrow rain at the landing point, and restore health equal to 2.5% of the damage dealt$(li)Arrows will pierce projectile protection$(li)Effect lasts 10 minutes

Using the great bow, the tome, and a rain of arrows as guidance, one can find the Lord's judgment.$(br)$(br)I will make my arrows drunk with blood, the blood of the slain and the captives. — Deuteronomy
